note: Help article on deploying Fin Voice on phone lines via Intercom Phone or call forwarding; notes Fin Voice is limited to select customers in US, EU and AU through sales.
Help article lists Messenger (web/in-app chat) as a core Fin channel.
Help article says Fin answers email, keeps the thread history, formats replies for email and filters spam/phishing.
Pricing page lists deployment channels including WhatsApp, SMS, Instagram, Facebook Messenger and Slack besides Messenger, email, voice and API.
Fin Voice can be assigned to numbers enabled in Intercom Phone settings (Simple deploy or Workflow).
Existing numbers can be connected by call forwarding from providers such as Amazon Connect, Genesys, Talkdesk, Five9; SIP supported depending on vendor, enabled by account team.
Italian is in the Fin AI Agent supported-language list; the Fin Voice article also lists Italian among its 29 voice languages.
Language list includes 21 of the 24 EU official languages (Irish, Maltese and Slovak not listed).
Data connectors link Fin to external systems to fetch data and take actions; Procedures can include code and data connectors.

Help article documents a Fin Agent API MCP server that external agents can call; a custom MCP connector (Fin as MCP client) is described on the integration page, noted there as US-hosted workspaces only.
Each Simulation is a multi-turn conversation between a simulated customer and Fin, scored against configured checks.
Evals group simulations by theme and can be re-run after changes; the article suggests re-running key Evals as a regression suite; pass/fail per simulation.

Evals article notes runs vary between runs but describes no repeated-trial or consistency metric. Queries: 'Intercom Fin simulations test AI agent simulated customer'; 'Intercom Fin simulation run multiple times consistency pass rate variability'.
An LLM judge, combined with deterministic checks, scores each Simulation against the configured criteria.
Evals article describes no calibration of the LLM judge against human labels and states there is no way to record whether a reviewer agrees with a result. Queries: as for eval_sim and eval_repeat.
Help article lists performance and optimize dashboards, AI-generated CX Score, Topics Explorer, conversation monitoring and custom reports; Monitors with scorecards documented separately.
On Fin Voice transfer the agent's ringing modal shows an AI summary; every call has recording, transcript and summary in the Inbox. Configurable handoff rules documented in Fin explained article.

No page found on detecting AI or synthetic-voice callers or on a declared-agent protocol. Queries: 'Intercom Fin personal AI agents detect AI agent customers PAP PACT agent-to-agent'; 'Fin Voice detect AI caller bot synthetic voice Intercom'.
Security page states data can be hosted in the US, EU or Australia based on residency needs.
Security page lists ISO 27001 (also ISO 27701 and ISO 42001).
Security page lists SOC 2 Type II.

AI Agent Disclosure help article covers disclosure controls tied to AI legislation and links an article named Fin and the AI Act; that article's text was not retrieved. Trust Center lists an AI Act item (not readable via fetch).
Pricing page bills Fin per outcome (resolutions and some other outcomes), max one per conversation; Fin Voice has custom pricing via sales. Prices not reproduced.
Deployment Services terms describe vendor-led onboarding, configuration and implementation; pricing page offers a self-serve 14-day trial.
